_comment: Frozen ground-truth overrides for the pack-corpus eval (hand-triaged from the
2026-07-17 REPORT.md FP/FN rows). Keyed by JAR sha1. label is the GOLDEN
install decision for a dedicated server: 'client' = must be skipped,
'server' = must be installed. Applied on top of Modrinth project labels by
scripts/eval_pack_corpus.js so accuracy is measured against stable truth.
Notes record why the Modrinth label was kept or overridden.
